bookmarks.label: First policy divergence
bookmarks.description: First synchronized event with different REAL and ZERO policy decisions.

bookmarks.label: Largest decision-divergence probability gap
bookmarks.description: Differing decision with the largest absolute REAL-minus-ZERO commit probability gap.

bookmarks.label: Downstream commit-boundary cascade
bookmarks.description: Both policies commit but their earlier choices yield different candidate boundaries.

bookmarks.label: Late-talk policy divergence
bookmarks.description: Late non-forced policy difference, useful for showing the effect persists beyond the opening.
